items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You said KCR makes me think of Phil Schaap. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, is he there no longer?

ctx.x: Yeah I do. The newest stuff I hear is on WGBO. I haven’t gone much deeper into things. I almost never do KCR. They have interesting stuff.
You said KCR makes me think of Phil Schaap.
Yeah, is he there no longer?
